status_note: Builder-authored and builder-tested against an independent in-test reference serializer plus one-off cross-checks in two other runtimes. NOT independently qualified; no Runtime or Control Plane implementation has been run against it. Contract preparation only: no source change.

valid.description: Worked example copied from docs/r08-v2-contract.md section 9 (completed binding); must reproduce the contract's binding_digest
valid.note: expected binding_digest equals the value printed in the contract

valid.description: Minimum-length (1 character) identifiers, including a leading digit
Maximum-length (128 character) identifiers in every identifier member
Mixed case and every permitted punctuation character (. _ : -) after the first character
Case variant of BV-001 tenant: valid and a DIFFERENT digest (no case folding)
Integer upper boundary 2147483647 (INTERIM, equals registry MAX_INT; see open question OQ-1)
Boundary digest values: all-zero, all-f, mixed lowercase hex
BV-001 with members in reverse order at every level: bytes unchanged (sorted-key canonicalization)
BV-001 as pretty-printed JSON with insignificant whitespace: bytes unchanged
BV-001 with ASCII characters written as JSON \u escapes: decodes to identical members, bytes unchanged (digest is over decoded members, never over received text)
effective_policy_digest of an explicit deny-all F1ab payload (see EP-004); differs per caller policy under one selection epoch

invalid.description: Cyrillic a U+0430 in place of Latin a; in `family`
fullwidth digit one U+FF11 as first character; in `scope.tenant`
decomposed e + U+0301 (NFD); must NOT be conflated with the NFC form; in `scope.authority_domain`
Kelvin sign U+212A (casefolds to k); in `record_id`
trailing newline (regex $ would accept; \Z must not); in `scope.tenant`
leading byte order mark U+FEFF; in `scope.institution`
hyphen U+2010 in place of hyphen-minus; in `record_id`
unlisted member snapshot_id (deliberately not a member)
unlisted member participation (deliberately not a member)
activation_ref null (registry form is not completed and has no digest)
selection_epoch is JSON true (bool is not an integer)
selection_epoch appears twice with different values
selection_epoch appears twice with the SAME value (still refused)
duplicate detected after JSON unescaping of the key name
document begins with a UTF-8 BOM (bytes EF BB BF)
one missing and one unknown member: field_missing is reported first
a wrong-type member and an out-of-set identifier: the type phase runs first
an unknown member and a wrong-type member: field_unknown is reported first
literal (unescaped) UTF-8 e-acute bytes in scope.tenant

bad_values.description: Cyrillic a U+0430 in place of Latin a
fullwidth digit one U+FF11 as first character
decomposed e + U+0301 (NFD); must NOT be conflated with the NFC form
trailing newline (regex $ would accept; \Z must not)
hyphen U+2010 in place of hyphen-minus

identifier_matrix.rule: every bad value placed in every identifier member of BV-001 must refuse field_invalid naming that member

guard_digest_checks.description: carried binding_digest differs in the last hex digit
carried binding_digest is the unprefixed sha256 (no domain separation)

effective_payloads.description: key order in the source object does not matter
non-ASCII allow-list entry (permitted in payload values, which are not identity identifiers); serializer must escape, not emit raw UTF-8

trust_snapshots.description: Normalized snapshot copied from docs/r08-v2-contract.md section 5; must reproduce the contract's fingerprint

Unsorted input: expected values are those of the NORMALIZED form (issuers by key_id, authority arrays lexicographic, revoked_key_ids sorted, revoked_selections by (selection_id, integer epoch), min_epochs by selection_id)

Non-ASCII strings inside the snapshot: registry serializer escapes (\u00e9 and the surrogate pair \ud83d\ude00); a serializer that emits raw UTF-8 (the Control Plane commitment profile uses ensure_ascii=False) produces DIFFERENT bytes and a different fingerprint, so it must not be used for the fingerprint
Empty collections are present as empty arrays (never omitted, never null)

trust_snapshots_invalid.description: two min_epochs floors for one selection_id
